samples_reviewed.question_text: One group has 1 item and another group has 63 items. Putting them together makes 63 items in all. True or False?
hints: We are adding two numbers: 1 and 63.
Add the ones: 1 + 3 = 4. Keep 4 in the ones place.
Add the tens: 0 + 6 = 6.
The sum is 1 + 63 = 64.
